derivation.selection: The handle is the narrow wrapped shaft around source Y=0, identified by the source mesh topology and its separate UV island (U 0.6659320592880249 through 0.7127493023872375). The pommel has a wider rounded lobe below it; the guard is the transverse component above it; the blade extends to the positive-Y tip. Inclusive source triangle ranges freeze this semantic selection to the exact source bytes.
derivation.interval: Compute the two midpoint planes in the empty centroid gaps between the handle triangles and the nearest excluded pommel/guard triangles. Validate that the existing axis-region utility selects exactly the 80 handle triangles, with zero blade/guard/pommel triangles. Do not expand the interval to obtain contact.
derivation.hand: Use the actual VRM-mapped wrist.r and its actual descendant skin bones, all triangle vertices at summed influence >=0.5. This selects rendered hand-region triangles, not articulated fingers or anatomical closure.
derivation.transform: Preserve the installed attachment matrix and every scene/node transform. Normalize the actual avatar bounds to 1.6 metres as the browser audit does. Bind-pose measurement is diagnostic, not production animation or visual approval.
